assumptions: The DeepHF model named, as its authors trained it.
limits: A prediction; trained on human cell lines.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: One predicted efficiency per protospacer. The score belongs to the guide table, whose reading is on crispr_design_guides; a sentence here would describe a column rather than a run.
bio.jane/contract.question: What knockout efficiency does DeepHF predict for each guide under this nuclease and promoter?

description: Score CRISPR guides with DeepHF: a predicted knockout EFFICIENCY between 0 and 1 for wild-type SpCas9 (U6 or T7 promoter), eSpCas9(1.1) or SpCas9-HF1. It is not a z-score and not comparable with Rule Set 3 — the two answer different questions and must never be averaged or ranked together. Takes 23-nt protospacers (20-nt spacer + NGG PAM), which is what `crispr_design_guides` produces; a guide whose PAM is not canonical NGG comes back null rather than extrapolated, because the model was trained on NGG only. THE WEIGHTS DOWNLOAD ON FIRST USE, 3-5 MB per model, and scoring is slow by construction: each guide is folded twice, once with the 79-nt tracrRNA scaffold, before the network sees it.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

model.description: which published model to score under. This is a scientific choice about YOUR experiment — which Cas9 variant, and which promoter the sgRNA is expressed from — not a quality setting, and scores from two models are not comparable. Values: wt_u6 (WT SpCas9 · U6 promoter), wt_t7 (WT SpCas9 · T7 promoter), wt (WT SpCas9 · both promoters), esp (eSpCas9(1.1)), hf (SpCas9-HF1).

protospacers.description: the 23-nt protospacers to score — 20-nt spacer plus the 3-nt PAM, exactly as DeepHF takes them. Anything that is not 23 nt of unambiguous A/C/G/T ending in GG scores null rather than being silently trimmed or extrapolated.

name: crispr_score_deephf

best.description: the highest-scoring protospacer, or empty when none could be scored

efficiencies.description: just the numbers, same order — null-preserving, so it lines up with the input

model.description: which model produced these numbers. Scores from two models are not comparable

scored.description: how many of the inputs DeepHF is defined on — the accounting, not an assumption

scores.description: every protospacer with its efficiency, IN THE ORDER GIVEN — null where DeepHF is not defined, with the reason beside it
